notes: Fixed assets tax book reference data for Kenyan companies (docs/modules/fixed-assets.md FA-20). Structure only: class keys. No method or rate is entered until it is confirmed from an official source with its legal reference and effective date; a class with a null method or rate, or needs_confirmation true, is unconfirmed and the tax book is refused. Labels live in lang/{locale}/fixed_assets.php (tax_classes.*).
todo: Income Tax Act, Second Schedule: confirm the official wear and tear classes and which assets fall in each.
buildings: method (straight line or reducing balance), annual rate and effective date, with the legal reference.
machinery: method, annual rate and effective date (including any split between heavy and other machinery).
motor_vehicles: method, annual rate and effective date.
computers: method, annual rate and effective date (computers, peripherals, calculators, copiers).
software: method, annual rate and effective date.
furniture: method, annual rate and effective date (furniture and fittings).
telecommunication: method, annual rate and effective date.
other: any other class (farm works, intangibles), its method and rate.
Investment deduction: whether it applies in the first year, for which assets and at what rate.
acquisition_rule: whether the year of acquisition counts as a full year (full_year) or pro rata by months in service (pro_rata_months), with the legal reference.
Disposals: the balancing allowance or charge in the year of disposal (until confirmed the tax book gives no allowance that year and computes no balancing adjustment).
